draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.95, the 180th-best grade among 257 2026 draftees and 27th of 36 at WR. He went 75th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (180th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing concerns: vertical jump (5th percentile). College production: 846 receiving yards in 2025, 16th of 36 WRs in his class with stats.
